findings.scenario: S22 (decay-gate honesty) — the DECAY-TRUE positive control
findings.observed: a serially-random (i.i.d., phi=0) series fabricated a TRACEABLE half-life, and a flat constant series slipped past the degenerate guard to TRACEABLE
findings.rootCause: (a) a fixed EPS=1e-4 floor alone let i.i.d. noise autocorrelations (~N(0, 1/n), std ~0.05 at n=400) creep above it, so the log-linear fit read noise as a persistent edge; (b) a flat constant series had a tiny floating-point positive variance (Sum(r-mu)^2 not exactly 0), so the autocorrelation denominator produced O(1) garbage that the fit consumed
findings.fix: (a) only an autocorrelation ABOVE the ~95% Bartlett white-noise band (Z/sqrt(n), Z=2) counts as a real edge -> a serially-random series has < 2 significant lags -> SHORT_LIVED (no persistence); (b) a scale-relative degenerate guard std > |mu|*1e-6 + 1e-15 (the Stamp's shape) -> INSUFFICIENT. DECAY_SIGNIF_Z pinned (conscious re-pin 46e40760... -> f157da69...).
findings.retest: phi=0 -> SHORT_LIVED; a flat series -> INSUFFICIENT; phi=0.95 -> TRACEABLE (~9.9); phi=0.5 -> SHORT_LIVED (~1.1); deterministic; two consecutive clean runs identical

findings.scenario: S22 (the enriched Stamp reason) — the DECAY-TRUE integration
findings.observed: a CONDITIONAL GO's base reason already says 'a clean GO is fenced off' (the POST-HOC fence); the decay clause re-used 'clean GO ... WITHHELD/fenced', conflating two distinct fences
findings.rootCause: the post-hoc (pre-registration) fence and the depth (persistence/consistency) hurdle are orthogonal, but shared the word 'fenced'/'clean GO'
findings.fix: the depth clause uses the distinct 'persistence/consistency hurdle for a clean GO is (NOT) cleared' framing; cleanGo is the DEPTH flag (a CONDITIONAL GO can be depth-clean yet post-hoc-fenced — both disclosed, never conflated). The verdict WORD is never minted/moved.
findings.retest: a persistent GO -> both depth hurdles cleared; an i.i.d. GO -> the persistence hurdle NOT cleared (GO word stands, discloses it survived); a lumpy GO -> the consistency hurdle NOT cleared; two consecutive clean runs identical

findings.scenario: S24 (build-evidence count) — a skipped test broke the battery-count parser
findings.observed: the Operator-gated live-AI test (ask_live) is SKIPPED offline, printing a ' N skip' line BETWEEN 'pass' and 'fail'; build-evidence's (\d+)\s+pass\s+(\d+)\s+fail regex assumed pass immediately precedes fail -> parsed -1/-1 -> verify failed on the count
findings.rootCause: the count regex was brittle to a skip/todo line between pass and fail
findings.fix: match pass and fail INDEPENDENTLY (the bun summary lines are the anchors) — robust to a skip line
findings.retest: build-evidence writes the true count (601/0 ... 617/0 ...); verify GREEN; two consecutive clean runs identical

convergence.battery: 625 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail across 102 files (626 tests), byte-identical across two consecutive runs; deterministic (the offline battery forces the AI keys empty, so the Operator-gated live-AI test skips)
